title: AI-Powered PBR Texture Generator: A Free Tool for Game Developers, Designers and 3D Artists
author: Cora_DigimansAI
selftext:
As fellow game developers, 3D artists, and AI enthusiasts, we understand the challenges faced in creating unique and realistic textures for games and other projects. That's why our small team from Warsaw has developed an AI-powered PBR texture generator - [https://textures.digimans.ai](https://textures.digimans.ai/), and we're excited to share it with you – for free!  
What does our PBR texture generator offer?  
**AI-Driven**: Utilizing advanced AI algorithms, our generator creates high-quality, realistic PBR textures.  
**Free for Everyone**: We believe in making resources accessible to all, so our PBR texture generator is available at no cost.  
**User-Friendly**: Our intuitive interface ensures that even beginners can easily generate PBR textures.  
**Time and Cost Efficient**: Save on purchasing texture packs or spending hours creating your own textures. Our AI is here to help!

We'd appreciate it if you could give our PBR texture generator a try and share your feedback with us. Your input will help us fine-tune the tool and make it even better for the community.  
If you're curious about the team behind this project or want to stay informed about our progress, feel free to follow us on Discord [https://discord.gg/jFmvSBYRjh](https://discord.gg/jFmvSBYRjh) or on Twitter. We'll be sharing updates, new features, and future developments as we continue to explore AI-driven solutions for game development.  
Thank you for your time, and we hope you find our AI-powered PBR texture generator useful!

Best regards,  
The Digimans.ai Team

**TL;DR:**  
Our small team from Warsaw has developed a free AI-Powered PBR texture generator for game developers and 3D artists. We invite you to try it out and share your feedback to help us improve the tool. Follow us to stay updated on our ongoing projects and advancements in AI-driven game development solutions.

comments.author: faithrolled
comments.body: You take my image AND THEN demand a sign up after upload? Shadey. I don't want to sign up. How can I remove my texture from your servers?

comments.author: LostInSpace2981
comments.body: Does this do tiling or image alignment? Distortion correction? Also the viewer is nice, but it would be better if the light was manually controlled so I can really see the output. Results were subpar IMO, but a step in the right direction - wishing you the best!
